Treatment summary
The patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot and was diagnosed with cervical whiplash.
Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the soft-tissue injury to the neck. The patient attended 27 visits over
the course of care, consisting of manual therapy, targeted home exercise instruction, and periodic reassessment.
Treatment followed a typical clinical progression, with visit frequency tapering as range of motion and pain levels
improved. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from the patient's history or available records. Billing records
reflect single, appropriate charges for each service without duplication. At this time, it is not yet clear whether the
injury resulted from this collision, as the timing and mechanism require further review alongside the patient's full
history. The patient was discharged to self-directed exercise with instrucitons to return if symptoms recur.
